meta.notes: Schema templates for datagen.py. typical_rows_per_month is a sizing hint for a mid-sized company; the generator scales by revenue and period count and caps total rows at 50,000 per case. All templates with gl_* tables must reconcile: sum(gl_lines.debit)=sum(gl_lines.credit) per entry; sub-ledgers (invoices, transactions, shipments) tie to GL revenue/AR except where an archetype's ground truth states the break. Dirt rules are applied by the generator after population, not encoded here.

saas_billing.description: Subscription billing + GL. Modeled on Stripe Billing objects (Customer, Subscription, Price/Plan, Invoice, InvoiceLineItem, PaymentIntent, UsageRecord), Zendesk-style tickets, and a NetSuite-style GL.

tables.name: subscriptions
tables.description: Subscription state per customer; one active per customer, history preserved.

tables.description: Invoice line items; recognised ratably over period_start..period_end.

tables.name: gl_lines
